batches.objective: Trace and repair one complete ordinary Vulkan acquire/render/present ownership handoff with explicit failure outcomes.
batches.rationale: The native attachment-admission batch is closed. The retained surface audit identifies missing presentation waits and success on out-of-date presentation; present_image still declares no wait semaphores. Reconfirm the actual consumer and submission handoff before changing synchronization.
batches.nextAction: Identify the public surface consumer, acquisition semaphore, draw submission and presentation dependencies; freeze windowed reproduction and failure/lifetime cases before editing.
acceptance: Preserve acquired-image identity and retain resources through known completion, including rejected submission, out-of-date presentation and recreation.
Observe native acquire/render/present ordering and independent pixels through an ordinary public consumer; report unavailable windowed or validation-layer evidence explicitly.
Retain focused tests, source identities and scoped cost observations without claiming whole-backend or release qualification.
batches.stopCondition: Stop after one complete surface submission handoff and retained evidence. Direct-command attachment admission and broader backend cleanup remain separate; completed query, native attachment, compiler, bundle and build-recipe batches stay closed.
requiredEnvironment: Linux Vulkan and an actual supported window-system surface; platform and validation-layer availability must be recorded.
